business_problem: Kythera Labs needed a cost-effective way to store, standardize, and process enormous volumes of structured and unstructured healthcare data so it could deliver analysis-ready datasets and derived products to healthcare and life sciences clients.
solution_summary: Kythera built its Wayfinder offering on the Databricks Data + AI Platform, using the lakehouse as the central hub for remastered healthcare data and derived products. The platform ingests structured and unstructured source data, then standardizes, improves, and transforms it into de-identified claims and patient-event assets that clients can analyze immediately. Spark Declarative Pipelines orchestrates and automates the ETL layer, keeping encounter-level data fresh and reliable while stripping away the complexity of updating massive patient cohorts. Delta Sharing distributes live data without copying or replication, which helps Kythera continuously improve source data while controlling storage costs. Unity Catalog governs secure access so each customer sees only the views they purchased. Together with scalable storage and parallel jobs on Databricks, the architecture turns petabyte-scale healthcare pipelines into analysis-ready products for analytics and machine learning.

solution_components.role: Provides the central lakehouse where Kythera remasters healthcare data and produces derived data products for clients.

solution_components.name: Spark Declarative Pipelines
solution_components.role: Automates and orchestrates ETL pipelines for patient-event assets and other analysis-ready healthcare datasets.

solution_components.name: Delta Sharing
solution_components.role: Shares live healthcare datasets with customers without copying or replicating the underlying data.

solution_components.name: Unity Catalog
solution_components.role: Applies secure access controls so customers receive only the remastered data views they purchased.

data_flow: Kythera collects raw healthcare data, standardizes and remasters it on the Databricks lakehouse, uses Spark Declarative Pipelines to build and refresh patient-event assets, and then serves live de-identified datasets through Delta Sharing under Unity Catalog controls so customers can analyze them immediately.
business_outcome: Kythera now manages over 45 terabytes of remastered healthcare data, cut query pipeline processing time by more than 99 percent, reduced a two-day query pipeline cycle to two to four minutes, lowered storage and processing spend, won at least three new clients, and helped one pharma customer save two years in development time.
architecture_clues: Wayfinder is Kythera's proprietary OEM offering built on the Databricks Data + AI Platform.
Streaming and processing run in a single lakehouse with scalable infrastructure and parallel jobs.
Delta Sharing lets Kythera improve source data continuously without copying or replication.
Unity Catalog enforces purchased-data views and secure sharing for clients.
evidence_quotes: The organization is using the Databricks Data + AI Platform — including Spark Declarative Pipelines, Delta Sharing and Unity Catalog — to deliver enormous remastered healthcare data sets and derived data products ready for analysis.
The company collects and manages data from about 2 billion medical transactions and approximately 3 billion prescription transactions annually.
Wayfinder now delivers access to over 45 terabytes of de-identified, remastered claims data.
To build a cohort of 5,000 or 10,000 rare disease patients, we have to sift through about 700 billion records.
Before Spark Declarative Pipelines (on Databricks), we could design, test and run a query pipeline in 2 days. With Spark Declarative Pipelines, we can do it in 2 to 4 minutes.
We’ve won at least three new clients because of how we're able to fast-track their analysis with data they can use immediately.
